sex.evidence: A total of 410 experimentally naive Wistar male rats

dosing.evidence: Mescaline.HCl (Sigma Aldrich) was dissolved in physiological saline and administered at doses of 10, 20, and 100 mg/kg, 60 min before testing. All drugs were administered subcutaneously at a volume of 2 ml/kg.

group_housing.evidence: housed in pairs in plastic cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: All experiments were conducted between 7 a.m. and 1 p.m.

assays.assay_description: Square black plastic box arena (68 × 68 × 30 cm); rats placed in center; locomotion (trajectory length) and time spent in center (9 central zones of 5x5 grid) measured for 30 min in 5-min intervals using EthoVision. Tested with mescaline (10, 20, 100 mg/kg) alone or in combination with 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, or 5-HT2C antagonists.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered subcutaneously at a volume of 2 ml/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: no apparatus habituation described for OFT

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in the center of the testing arena, and locomotion was measured for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: standard OFT apparatus; food not accessible during recording

water_restriction.evidence: standard OFT apparatus; water not accessible during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: administered at doses of 10, 20, and 100 mg/kg, 60 min before testing

sample_size.evidence: Each experimental group consisted of 9 to 10 animals for locomotor activity measurements (N = 190)

outcomes.summary: Mescaline produced biphasic effects on locomotion: low doses (10, 20 mg/kg) decreased locomotion in the first 5-10 min, while 100 mg/kg induced hyperlocomotion across all time intervals. The hyperlocomotion at 100 mg/kg was fully reversed by 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 and partially reversed by SB215505 (5-HT2B), SB242084 (5-HT2C), and WAY100635 (5-HT1A). Time spent in center was increased at 100 mg/kg and attenuated by all antagonists except WAY100635.
outcomes.evidence: low doses of mescaline (10 and 20 mg/kg) significantly decreased locomotion in the first (0-5 min) and second (5-10 min) time intervals, while mescaline 100 mg/kg significantly increased locomotion compared to saline in all time intervals

B1_num_measures.evidence: locomotion (trajectory length) and its spatial characteristics (time spent in the center of the arena)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: locomotor activity was measured in 5-min intervals... two-way RM ANOVA with time interval as a repeated measures factor

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: no analysis of behavioural sequences reported

B4_ethological.evidence: measures were trajectory length and time in center (spatial measures)

B6_cognitive.evidence: open field does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using EthoVision version 3.1.1 software (position tracking)

E1_environment_type.evidence: square black plastic box arena (68 × 68 × 30 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: plastic box arena cleaned with 10% ethanol after each test

E6_spatial.evidence: open field with virtual zones only

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed in the center of the testing arena (individually)

E8_food_water.evidence: no food or water in the arena

D1_continuity.evidence: locomotion was measured for 30 min; Each experimental subject was tested only once

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each experimental subject was tested only once

D5_followup.evidence: tested 60 min after administration; no follow-up >=24 h

assays.assay_name: Prepulse Inhibition of Acoustic Startle Reaction
assays.assay_description: Startle chambers (SR-LAB) with Plexiglas cylinder (8.2 cm diameter) on piezoelectric platform. After 5-min acclimatization with 65 dB background, five initial 120 dB startle trials (excluded), then pseudo-random presentation of pulse alone (120 dB), prepulse+pulse, prepulse alone (70 dB), and no-stimulus trials. Measures ASR amplitude and %PPI.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered subcutaneously at a volume of 2 ml/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: 5-min acclimatization within the test session, but no separate pre-test habituation described

setup_restrain.evidence: Plexiglas cylinder of 8.2 cm diameter (startle chamber restraint)

food_restriction.evidence: standard PPI apparatus; food not accessible during recording

water_restriction.evidence: standard PPI apparatus; water not accessible during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: administered at doses of 10, 20, and 100 mg/kg, 60 min before testing

sample_size.evidence: 10 to 12 animals for sensorimotor gating testing (N = 220)

outcomes.summary: Mescaline produced PPI deficits across doses without significantly altering ASR amplitude. The 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 restored PPI deficits at all mescaline doses, while the 5-HT2C antagonist SB242084 partially restored the deficit at 20 mg/kg mescaline. Other antagonists had minimal effects on PPI.
outcomes.evidence: only M100907 restored PPI ASR deficit for all mescaline doses (p < 0.05 -0.01) and SB242084 at a dose of 20 mg/kg of mescaline (p = 0.0017)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Acoustic startle amplitude (ASR) and percentage PPI were measured

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: no analysis of behavioural sequences reported

B4_ethological.evidence: startle is a reflex, not an ethological behaviour

B6_cognitive.evidence: PPI is a sensorimotor gating reflex, not learned

B7_automated_classification.evidence: piezoelectric accelerometer measures startle amplitude; no behavioural classification

E3_bedding.evidence: Plexiglas cylinder on platform; no bedding

E4_nesting.evidence: no nesting material in startle chamber

E5_enrichment.evidence: no enrichment objects in startle chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat tested individually in startle chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: no food or water accessible during the test

D1_continuity.evidence: Each experimental subject was tested only once

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5-min acclimatization plus brief startle/prepulse trials; total session duration not explicitly stated but standard PPI is short

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each experimental subject was tested only once

D5_followup.evidence: tested 60 min after administration; no follow-up >=24 h

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on two assays (Open Field Test and PPI ASR) — kept as-is.
Set day_night_flipped to 'no' (per glm) based on explicit statement 'All experiments were conducted between 7 a.m. and 1 p.m.' (light phase testing).

PPI setup_restrain: scored 'yes' per qwen and glm — the rubric explicitly lists PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes/cylinders as restraint. The 8.2 cm Plexiglas cylinder restricts movement during recording.
Food/water restriction: scored 'during' for both assays per rubric guidance that standard short tests where the apparatus has no food/water = 'during'.

OFT time_dependent: scored 'yes' because effect direction varies across the 30-min session (hypolocomotion early, hyperlocomotion sustained at 100 mg/kg) — though all timepoints are within one session, the 5-min interval analysis shows time-dependent modulation.
PPI D2 session duration scored 0 (<15 min) with low confidence — total session duration not explicitly stated in numbers.
